details:
Multiple security issues were discovered in Tomcat.

Tomcat 10 has been updated to 10.1.61 in Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04
LTS and Ubuntu 26.10. Tomcat 11 has been updated to 11.0.27 in Ubuntu
26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10.

In addition to security fixes, the updated packages contain bug fixes, new
features, and possibly incompatible changes.

Please see the following for more information:

https://tomcat.apache.org/security-10.html
https://tomcat.apache.org/security-11.html
